name: Elaris Fenbough
source_profile:
Elder Elaris Fenbough (NG)

A patient and respected leader, Elaris believes peaceful coexistence is possible, provided Cador formally recognizes Velthari territory and agrees to enforce restrictions on logging and settlement. She has already entered negotiations with representatives of Marquessa Elowen Harrowmont. Elaris is neither naive nor particularly trusting. She understands that the Cadorians possess considerable military resources, and that prolonged war could be disastrous for her people.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 64 (source excerpt; may be partial)
